text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The first three years of the Twinkle Series with Tamamo Cross have come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her results were quite impressive.
With such great success, unexpected offers
began coming in—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whaaat, manga?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"You wanna use me as the model for a manga protagonist?
...Are ya for real?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A manga... By manga, you mean *that* kind of manga...?
Me, starring in a manga...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I hadn't thought of that at all.
But...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"The little ones might love it.
They could brag at the local park, saying,
'Look, that's my big sis Tama!'..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"The little ones must be so proud.
Everyone cheering 'em on, making 'em feel like stars."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Still~, it's kinda embarrassing. Me, drawn in a manga~. Hmmm, what should I do...
choice_data_list: Could it help out with household expenses, though?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—!?
You should've said that first!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... If my name recognition shoots
way up, then just as much...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: In that case, there's no need to think twice! Alright, I'll take that offer! And for the races from here on—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ngaah~, do your best and run!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Did I just say
something weird...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well, whatever. Now then, let's start the meeting right away...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama! Trainer! Listen to this!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oguri, what's up?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Apparently, a manga starring me is going to start soon.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's that? You too?
Talk about a coincidence, or whatever you wanna call it...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: We're pretty popular, huh...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So, I have a favor to ask. Won't you appear in my manga, Tama?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "It wouldn't be exciting at all without you, and that's just out of the question."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: A manga about Oguri, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, fine by me. But since you're the one
who brought this to me, you know what to expect, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Things are gonna turn real ugly, for sure.
choice_data_list: Don't tell me... is that to help with the household finances too?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: *Faceplants*! No way! If I'm runnin', I ain't lettin' the star get all the glory!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri! From here on out, I'm gonna beat ya in every race!
And I'll flip the script.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ain't no telling who the star really is! If ya don't wanna get upstaged, come at me with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama...! Ah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, today as well, the two of them
rush off to the training grounds together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The White Lightning's fame extended far beyond
the races, taking the newspapers by storm.
